$comment: Shot list entry (sand-y0u.6): the manifest is ahead of the binary. The image has NOT been fetched yet — run the download in docs/imagery-phase-1.md, then `npm run media`. Provenance verified against the archive record on 2026-08-24.

original.description: Crown Prince Wilhelm in the uniform of the 1. Leib-Husaren-Regiment; a detail cropped from a family portrait by the Hamburg studio of Emil Bieber.
original.archive: Wikimedia Commons; the record cites the photograph collection of Huis Doorn (fotocollectie.huisdoorn.nl)
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; the record qualifies the non-US status separately)

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — the Leib-Husaren attila is documented (black with white lace, the Totenkopf on the busby), which is exactly the kind of colour ADR 0007 allows to be asserted.

caption: Wilhelm, German Crown Prince, who commanded the Fifth Army in the Ardennes and before Verdun in 1914. Photographed before the war in the uniform of the 1st Life Hussars.
credit: Original photograph: E. Bieber, 1912/13; via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Low resolution (506 px wide) — good enough for a person card, not for a hero image.
